name: Lesson 3 Take it easy（别紧张/放轻松）
definition: 学习表达失败和难过情绪，学会面对失败、调整心态并寻求他人帮助。
key_points: 核心词汇：sad, worried, fail(ed), monitor, High Jump Club, join, test, hand in, on time, feel sorry, take it easy, plan, try one's best, give up, lucky (含中文：伤心的、担心的、失败、班长、跳高俱乐部、参加、考试、交、及时、感到抱歉、放轻松、计划、尽力、不放弃、幸运的)
核心句型：I am sad / worried because... / I tried to ..., but I failed.
核心句型：Take it easy. You can make a better plan next time.
核心句型：Don't worry about it. You are the best. You can make it next time.
核心句型：I will try my best. / I won't give up.
语法点：一般过去式（I tried / I failed / I didn't make it）；because 引导原因状语从句
common_mistakes: try to do 与 try doing 混淆（试做某事用 try to do）
felt 误写为 falled，混淆过去式与动词原形
publisher: 广东教育出版社（粤教沪外教版）
